prompts.prompt: The last time I laughed way too hard
prompts.answer: My sourdough starter, Gerald, escaped its jar overnight and colonised a shelf. I apologised to it out loud. Tell me your worst kitchen crime.

prompts.prompt: I'll pick the topic if you start the conversation
prompts.answer: Whether Busan or Gwangjang market does the better hangover breakfast. I've researched it twice, and I'm still willing to be wrong. Convince me.
Hunt down the best gukbap within six blocks, then argue about the winner on the walk home. Let's start on a Saturday. Bring strong opinions.
